display.$description: Anything scanned: keys, titles, labels, captions (the body face unless a theme says otherwise)

mono.$description: Codes and IDs a player might type

control.$description: Buttons, fields, rows, the primary face
Buttons and bar items / large glyph

field.$description: Text inputs, selects and dialog buttons

stroke.$description: Stroke width of every icon (Hugeicons draw at 1.5)

base.$description: Body size; every step derives from it

figure.$description: A number that is the point (the figure style); a component re-points it for its size

row.$description: A row or notice title (the label voice)

desc.$description: A row or notice description (the body voice)

title.$description: Titles and sections (a ratio of the size)

display.$description: Full-screen titles and HUD values (a ratio of the size)

figure.$description: A number that is the point: a clock, a balance, the speed (a ratio of the size)

skew.$description: The slant of faces (keys, the primary button, the selection; boxes and text stay upright): 0 = upright, at most ±20deg

slab.$description: Chips, badges and tags drawn as skewed slabs too (0deg = upright); at most ±20deg

cut.$description: Chamfered corners (top left, bottom right) as clip-path; 0 = off

stroke.$description: Hairline weight of plates, rims and fields

ratio.$description: Step between type sizes: 1.125 calm … 1.333 dramatic

case.$description: Anything scanned (keys, titles, labels, captions) in caps or as written

overhang.$description: Trailing pad of a slanted voice (the italic's overhang); 0em when upright

Trailing pad of the numeric voice (the italic overhang)

elevation.$description: Shadow recipe: hard is a solid offset drop, no blur

glow-budget.$description: How many parts may glow at once (0 = no limit)

backdrop.$description: Backdrop blur (FiveM draws it as a black box: off)

legibility.$description: day lifts surfaces for a bright sky; auto follows the game clock

legibility-lift.$description: How far day closes the gap to opaque

opacity.$description: Opacity of the menu material (floor 0.92 for text)

blur.$description: Backdrop blur behind menus (with surface.backdrop on)

radius.$description: Corner radius of menus, sheets and dialogs

edge.$description: The machined top edge of menus (alpha)

text.$description: Shadow under text drawn on the game (semantic depth.text draws it)

motion.$description: 1 = animations on, 0 = off (painted 0 under the player's reduced-motion pref)

duration.$description: Base duration d: the ladder is snap 0.5d, fast 0.667d, base d, slow 1.556d, fill 2.333d

feel.$description: How it moves: crisp, snap (flash instead of press scale), smooth (longer springs), stepped

bounce.$description: Bounce folded into the snap, move and soft springs

exit-factor.$description: Every exit is this × its enter

reduced.$description: Under reduced motion every fade is at most this

profile.$description: full: as designed; reduced: no movement, short fades; instant: nothing animates

fill.$description: Fills, the selection face and levels: solid (flat, vivid) or soft (a tint)

level.$description: How a level (0–1) is drawn by vitals, meters, holds

hold.$description: How a press-and-hold shows its progress

focus.$description: Focus on parts that are not rows (rows and buttons light like hover)

pause.$description: The pause menu: a full-height sheet, or a light slash panel

info.$description: How long an info notice stays

success.$description: How long a success notice stays

danger.$description: How long a danger notice stays

glow.$description: A role's glow (under the glow budget)

dialog.$description: Stacking layer: dialog (a modal is the current surface + dim + dialog)
